{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Rogelo''''' was a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B frigate]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

When a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] destroyed the Rebel [[Probe droid|Probe]] [[PR-V74]], the fighter was on its way to the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Astin]] when the frigate arrived and began launching [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] to destroy the fighter. However, the frigate was unsuccessful and lost most, if not all fighters.

The event was recorded for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot]]s. One of those pilots who played this mission was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
